findings.what: The kit's external GitHub anchors (ShaLink githubHref, FileLineLink) carry no rel="noreferrer"; U3 renders many of them. Carried over from attempt 2, still open.
findings.why: W2 says external links carry rel="noreferrer". MarkdownText and the Matrix and Rule pages set it. ShaLink (lines 45-61) and FileLineLink (line 17) do not. The kit files are outside this diff, but the U3 pages are the heaviest users. The leak is only the page URL to github.com, and there is no target=_blank. This is hygiene and doesn't block.

W1 met: a grep of src/web finds no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval( or new Function in app or compiler code. Trail, verdict, finding and plan text render through JSX text nodes, JsonViewer, or the kit's MarkdownText, which filters hrefs by scheme. The new Plan question and hypothesis, and the Loop completenessReasons, go through MarkdownText.

W2 met for U3's own links. External hrefs are built by commitUrl and blobUrl in shell/repo.ts, which fix the prefix to https://github.com/dpmorgandev/uinsure-policies-api. The head SHA used as the file link base comes from a 40-hex regex, and GateRef takes only [0-9a-f]{7,40}. Every other href is an internal '#/...' hash route, with rule ids passed through encodeURIComponent. A route param can't produce a javascript: scheme because every route href starts with '#'. blobUrl doesn't encode the data-supplied path, but it can't change host or scheme. The only gap is S1, a P2.
